SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Am. m.]
Watery, acrid coryza, corroding the lip.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Am. m.]
The various affections of bowels are accompanied by flatus. θ Prevailing fever.
Hard, crumbling stools, requiring great effort in their expulsion.
Obstinate and extreme constipation.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Am. m.]
During menses : diarrhœa and vomiting ; bloody discharge from bowels ; neuralgic pains in feet.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Am. m.]
Severe pain in lumbo-sacral region. θ Prevailing fever.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Am. m.]
Tension in joints as from shortening of muscles.
